module "P_WindField.dsp"

product 0 PassPipeline "P_WindField"
  pipeline order=0 injection=BeforePostProcess views=Game|Editor requires=- enabled=-
  parameter "WindDirection" float2 default=(1, 0)
  parameter "Gust" float default=0.5 slider=(0, 2)
  buffer "Wind" RG16F resolution=Fixed size=256x256 clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1 history export desc="xy = the wind vector; tiles world XY every 50 m."
  pass "Simulate" compute injection=BeginView
    shader "WindField.usf" virtual="" entry=WindCS
    threads=(8, 8, 1) (from the shader) dispatch=Wind * 1
    read Previous = Wind.Previous
    write Result = Wind
    param Direction = WindDirection * 1 + 0
    param Strength = Gust * 1 + 0
